items.name: Spec Compliance
items.note: AC-1..7 each have a test (run-plugin unit tests plus the real-CLI integration test); every refusal path asserts a byte-identical run config.

items.name: Error Handling
items.note: A blank skip reason is refused before the lock; redispatch refusals surface as claim_failed with no loop-state write; a split-read raise returns freeze_splits_failed before completion.

items.name: Security Basics
items.note: The operator reason is normalised to one printable line capped at 500 chars, JSON-encoded into the event detail, and the schema says to render it as data.

items.name: Test Quality
items.note: Mutation checks (rotation, freeze guard, gate hook, in-lock freeze) make the new tests fail; no assertion was weakened, and the e2e guided test now also asserts that the first descriptor is refused stale_version.

items.name: Performance Basics
items.note: One extra locked read-modify-write per re-dispatch only; the design freeze adds no lock because it rides the completion's write.

items.name: Naming & Structure
items.note: The new completion_hook.py (52 LOC) keeps single_session_apply.py under 300 LOC; apply_frozen_splits is shared by freeze_splits and the hook; the grandfathered files did not grow.

items.name: Affected Boundaries
items.note: All four producer/consumer rows round-trip through the real CLI: run_config skipReason, gate and version, plus the tracked phase_skipped event read back by the integration test.

items.name: Test Hygiene Probe
items.note: scan_test_hygiene.py --diff reports no findings for the changed test files.
